summary: The diff adds a global pending/loading UI and a dark-theme error fallback, and refactors router setup in App.tsx to use TanStack Router default pending/error components. However, the required auth/onboarding guarding is not implemented via TanStack Router route lifecycle; instead, imperative navigation is moved into LoginPage/OnboardingPage useEffects, and there is no evidence that direct-entry routes like '/', '/exercises', or '/plans' are guarded against unauthenticated or missing-profile states.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement route-level guarding/redirect behavior using TanStack Router mechanisms (e.g., route beforeLoad/loader redirection or equivalent) so that authentication and onboarding redirects happen within the router lifecycle rather than from AppContent render logic.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows imperative redirects handled via useNavigate() inside page components (LoginPage/OnboardingPage) rather than route lifecycle hooks like beforeLoad/loader. No route definitions in App.tsx show beforeLoad/loader-based redirects/guards for auth or onboarding state.

missing_requirements.requirement: When unauthenticated, the app renders a Login screen (or a loading screen while auth initializes) without rendering a blank page.
missing_requirements.reason: While a loading screen is added, there is no evidence of router-level protection that routes unauthenticated users to /login when they directly enter '/', '/exercises', or '/plans'. The route tree in App.tsx defines authenticated pages under the '/' layout but shows no auth guard/redirect on that layout or its children.

missing_requirements.requirement: When authenticated but missing a user profile, the app routes to /onboarding without any render-loop/blank-screen behavior (including on direct entry to '/', '/exercises', '/plans').
missing_requirements.reason: Redirect-to-/onboarding logic appears only within LoginPage (after authentication) rather than as a router guard for other routes. There is no evidence of route-level handling to send an authenticated user without a profile to /onboarding when entering other URLs directly.

missing_requirements.requirement: When authenticated and onboarding is complete, navigating to /onboarding redirects back to / without a blank screen.
missing_requirements.reason: OnboardingPage uses useNavigate() in a useEffect to redirect when a profile exists, not a router lifecycle redirect. The requirement calls for routing/redirect behavior to be handled by the router lifecycle (and this also overlaps with REQ-18).

hallucinated_features.description: Unrequested modifications to non-routing product pages (Dashboard/Profile/Upgrade) beyond the scope of fixing routing/redirect behavior.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly limits scope to fixing routing/redirect behavior and preventing blank screens; the diff summary indicates changes to multiple pages unrelated to routing fixes.
